ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Saturn

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.
